description: Is there an avalanche report at all right now, and in which regions? Lists every warning region in the Alps with a current report, grouped by warning service, with validity. Off season most regions have none. Contains no danger levels: use avalanche_bulletin for those.

lang.description: Language for region names and, if the service publishes in it, report texts. Default en.

name: avalanche_coverage

anyCurrentReport.description: Does any region in the Alps have a current report?

appUrl.description: Opens this in the topo^alpin app. Share it with the user.

dataStale.description: True: the data is older than its source is refreshed, or the source reports a fault. Say that it may be outdated. null: unknown, not fresh.

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the data behind this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC; a date for a fixed release). With several sources, the oldest. null: unknown.

disclaimer.description: Pass this on with every danger level: errors in processing are possible.

missing.description: Present where a report is missing. Pass it on.

lastCheckedAt.description: When the service was last checked successfully, with or without a report. With state error, nothing is known since then. null: unknown.

lastPublishedAt.description: When the latest report came out. With state empty it has expired: say that there is no report now, not that it still applies.

proof.description: Where the service states this licence.

license.description: The licence of the reports. null: the service names none.

regions.description: Every region of this service with a current report.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app.

state.description: ok: reports fetched. empty: the service was checked and publishes no current report, e.g. off season. error: fetching or reading failed, so whether a report exists is unknown; say so. unknown: no state for this service.

sources.description: Name these when using the data.

title: Where avalanche reports exist
